description: Create an application — the container that will own environments and secrets. This step needs no key material, so it runs here. Creating its environments does NOT: create_env mints a data key and lives on the local crypto plane (call setup_local_crypto). Returns the new { id, orgId, name, slug, createdAt }.

name.description: Human-readable display name, e.g. "Acme Storefront". Can be renamed later.

org.description: Organization slug or id. Omit it when the credential can reach exactly one org — that org is used automatically. With several, the error names every slug you may pass; list them yourself with list_orgs.

slug.description: URL-safe identifier used by every other tool to refer to this app: lowercase letters, numbers, hyphens (e.g. "acme-storefront"). Immutable once created — choose it carefully.

name: create_app
